name: Plantation
dining_districts: the Broward Mall and Fashion Mall redevelopment dining
the office corridors along Cypress Creek and Pine Island
intro: Plantation is Broward's office town — headquarters campuses and mid-rise corridors that keep a serious weekday lunch economy running, anchored by the newer Plantation Walk mixed-use district and the long restaurant row along University Drive. Hotels and conference kitchens feed the business traffic; family dining rooms and caterers cover nights and weekends.

Lunch-driven kitchens live and die by morning delivery, so Plantation stops are scheduled early on the central Broward run — about twenty minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse. Weekday-heavy accounts run five-day standing orders that skip weekends without penalty; hotel and banquet kitchens flex around the conference calendar; and everyone gets the midnight cutoff when tomorrow's booking sheet changes tonight.
route_note: About 20 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse — an early stop on the central Broward run, timed for lunch-driven kitchens.

faqs_unique.q: Can Plantation kitchens run weekday-only delivery schedules?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Standing orders can run any pattern — five-day weekday schedules are common for office-corridor kitchens, with weekend adds only when you book events.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to Plantation Walk and University Drive restaurants?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Both are regular stops on the central Broward morning route, with timing set to each kitchen's receiving window.

cta_text: Tell us what your office-corridor lunch service, family dining room, catering team, or hospitality kitchen needs, and we will shape your produce order around real demand.
